rationale_summary: The prior funding positioning-fade family preserved its full 36-row denominator and failed primarily through extreme drawdown. A bounded, a-priori risk layer tests that failure mode without changing the funding signal, direction, timeframe, or entry thresholds.
prior_failure_mode: All 36 prior price-PnL funding-fade rows failed the 20% drawdown screen; full-history drawdown ranged from 80.72% to 100% depending on exit mode.

why_other_lanes_are_not_first.price_only: Current price-only repo truth contains multiple canonical NO-GO populations and blocked attempts; it does not surface a cleaner first resumed edge-search run than testing a risk layer against the already isolated funding-fade drawdown failure.
why_other_lanes_are_not_first.taker_flow: Current synthesis records taker-flow as blocked by runner/data support, so it is not the first Stage 1 run without separate infrastructure work.
why_other_lanes_are_not_first.open_interest: Current inspected repo truth does not contain a runner-ready full-history open-interest hypothesis path with frozen denominator and pre-run approval materials.

strategy_agnostic_guardrail: This is test traffic for the generic Side 12 lab, not a funding-specific lab pivot.
